article_title: 如何记住你读过的一切，以及为什么你不该这么做
core_theme: 理解比记忆重要，学习是通过目标驱动的项目实践自然发生的过程
reader_takeaway: 理解控制论学习模型，获得一套不需要死记硬背的知识内化方法
summary_angle: 对抗「囤积知识」的焦虑：目标 → 过滤 → 相关性 → 自然记忆，学习是输出驱动的闭环

information_blocks.source_anchor: 控制论模型：目标创造误差信号，误差信号创造过滤器，过滤器创造相关性，相关性创造记忆
information_blocks.visual_idea: 一个循环流程：目标 → 过滤器 → 相关性 → 记忆，形成闭环

information_blocks.source_anchor: 别先学，先做项目；After Effects 的例子：想清楚要做什么再学需要的技巧
information_blocks.visual_idea: 项目中心节点连接所需技能，而非泛泛学习

information_blocks.source_anchor: 学习是输出过程，不是输入过程；输出才驱动输入
information_blocks.visual_idea: 从大脑到外部的输出箭头，表示写作/创作/表达

main_metaphor: 舵手在知识海洋中航行，目标指引方向，过滤掉无关风浪，留下真正重要的航线
primary_subject: 一个舵手/领航者在知识海洋中控制方向，周围是信息洪流但只有一部分被聚焦
subject_action: 舵手握舵轮，前方有明确的目标标记，身边的噪音和信息流被过滤机制筛掉
composition: 左右对照：左侧杂乱信息流 vs 右侧清晰聚焦路径
selected_style_prompt_descriptor: watercolor comic illustration, translucent washes, visible paper texture, soft edges, light ink structure
selected_style_reason: 用户未指定风格，本篇从 40 项风格池随机选中；文章关于阅读、学习和思考，水彩的温柔质感适合表达反思性主题
style_safety_note: 清单风格为泛类型描述，不涉及品牌、工作室或艺术家复刻
draft_goal: 验证主题（舵手/知识航行隐喻）和左右对照构图是否清晰
revision_targets: 如果隐喻不够清楚，加强舵手与知识海洋的联系
如果左右对照太生硬，柔化为动态过渡
如果水彩质感被科技风覆盖，收紧风格词
final_prompt:
Use case: infographic-story
Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article
Primary request: Create a wide infographic-story cover illustration. Theme: Knowledge and learning — understanding over memorization, learning as a goal-driven cybernetic process. The reader should feel this is about a smarter approach to learning and retaining knowledge.

Summary angle: Against knowledge hoarding anxiety — goal creates filter, filter creates relevance, relevance creates natural memory. Learning is an output-driven closed loop.
Narrative flow: conflict-to-resolution. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject and 2-3 supporting narrative beats.
Information blocks:
- mechanism: A cybernetic flow: goal → filter → relevance → memory, labeled 「目标驱动」
- contrast: A project-centered node connecting needed skills rather than scattered general learning, labeled 「先做项目」
- takeaway: An output arrow from mind to external world representing writing/creating, labeled 「输出驱动」

Main metaphor: A steersman navigating through a sea of knowledge, the goal guiding direction, filtering out irrelevant noise.
Subject: A navigator/helmsman steering through knowledge currents, with clear target ahead and noise filtered away.
Composition: Left-right contrast — cluttered information flow on the left vs. clear focused path on the right. Prefer horizontal storytelling that stays legible in a wide cover.
Style/medium: combine conceptual editorial illustration with the selected visual style descriptor: watercolor comic illustration, translucent washes, visible paper texture, soft edges, light ink structure. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist.
Color palette: indigo blue (#2c3e50), warm yellow (#e8c547), light gray-white background.
Visible text policy: allow only 2-3 short Chinese labels: 「目标驱动」「先做项目」「输出驱动」. Each label <= 4 Chinese characters. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI.
Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter.
Avoid: floating chips, code rain, neon buildings, generic robots, cyberpunk light pollution, HUD overlays, fake UI, fake charts, watermarks.
